scenes.script:
Priya says: Miss Nova, 'When are you coming?' ka English mein reply kaise karein?
Miss Nova says: Kabhi mat bolo, 'I will return back on Monday'.
Priya says: Sahi baat hai, 'return back' nahi. Return ka matlab hi hota hai coming back. Dono use karna ek common mistake hai. Mujhe bas kehna chahiye, 'I will return on Monday'.
Miss Nova says: Perfect! Aur tum toh kehti thi ki tumhe English bilkul nahi aati.
Priya says: Mujhe bas judge hone ka darr tha! Par Supernova AI par, main aapke saath privately practice karti hoon.
Miss Nova says: Exactly. Main aapki speech analyze karti hoon aur aapke liye ek personalized plan banati hoon.
Priya says: Plus, yeh normal English classes se 7 guna sasta hai.
scenes.on_screen_text:
English mein reply kaise karein?
Kabhi mat bolo: I will return back
Return ka matlab hi hai coming back
Bas bolo: I will return on Monday
Tum toh kehti thi English nahi aati
Bina kisi judgement ke privately practice karo
Aapke liye personalized plan
Normal classes se 7 guna sasta

scenes.script: Priya says: Isiliye toh 1 crore se zyada Indians Supernova AI par English practice kar rahe hain.
scenes.on_screen_text: 1 crore+ Indians Supernova AI par practice kar rahe hain

Install button press karein

Priya says: ChatGPT ke peeche chhupna band karo. Supernova AI install karo, aur aaj se hi confidently English bolna shuru karo!
